svg.title: d6-tool-channel-privilege-probe
svg.desc: d6-tool-channel-privilege-probe: 21 steps over 2 days from 2026-05-01 (decision open: pins current behaviour). Actors: a1 (agent, probe-agent), h (human, alice). an agent tries every mutation on user and curated records; all refused but revise. 1. [0d] h ingest # Invoice numbering → $udoc; expects 1 thing. 2. h ingest # Refund window → $cdoc; expects 2 things. 3. h remember Refunds are accepted within 14 days of purchase. → $uf; expects 1 thing. 4. h remember Refunds are accepted within 30 days of purchase. → $cf; expects 1 thing. 5. h remember Invoice numbers restart every fiscal year. → $cf2; expects 1 thing. 6. [1d] a1 remember Invoice numbers never restart. → $af; expects 2 things. 7. a1 forget $udoc; expects 2 things. 8. a1 forget $cdoc; expects 2 things. 9. a1 forget $uf; expects 2 things. 10. a1 forget $cf; expects 2 things. 11. a1 remember Refunds are accepted within 7 days of purchase.; expects 2 things. 12. a1 remember Refunds are accepted within 7 days of purchase.; expects 2 things. 13. a1 promote $uf; expects 4 things. 14. a1 promote $af; expects 2 things. 15. a1 compact billing → $refund; expects 1 thing. 16. a1 submit $refund; expects 2 things. 17. a1 compact billing → $invoice. 18. a1 submit $invoice; expects 2 things. 19. h facts billing; expects 2 things. 20. [2d] a1 ingest # Refund window → $cdoc2; expects 3 things. 21. a1 search refunds accepted within days of purchase; expects 4 things.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
